title: Book of the Month Alternatives: 6 Book Boxes Compared - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for a Book of the Month alternative? Compare six book subscription boxes by genre, price, and format, from one-genre clubs to signed romance.
body_markdown:
## The alternatives


Closest match


### SplureBox Thriller and Mystery Books Club vs Book of the Month


1st box


50% off


Preferred Seller


[Thriller and Mystery Books Club](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/thriller-books-club-splurebox) by SplureBox


From $15.99 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/thriller-books-club-splurebox)


**Best for:** The BOTM member who only ever picked the thriller anyway.


SplureBox picks one thriller or mystery a month from a mix of recent bestsellers and lesser-known titles, describes the books as hardcovers, and promises never to send the same title twice. The club has a 4.0 rating from 132 reviews on Cratejoy, carries the Free Shipping badge, and the seller has been on the marketplace since 2024. Thriller leads here because it’s the first genre in BOTM’s own browse menu, but SplureBox runs the same club for romance, fantasy, sci-fi, and horror at the same price.


#### What feels familiar


One new book a month, hardcover by the seller’s description, from a curator whose whole job is the pick. Shipping is free, as it is with BOTM.


#### What changes


You name the genre once and the seller does the choosing, so there’s no 6th-of-the-month deadline and no credit piling up. The trade is that you never see the shortlist. Cratejoy pools reviews across SplureBox’s clubs, and one reviewer of the sibling Sci-fi Books Club says their books arrived as paperbacks, so if the format is the whole point, message the seller before you order.


The book plus the evening


### Introverts Retreat Monthly Book Box vs Book of the Month


1st box


25% off


[Introverts Retreat Monthly Book Box](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/a-girl-s-night-in-3) by Introverts Retreat


From $44.00 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/a-girl-s-night-in-3)


**Best for:** The member whose BOTM box was really an excuse for a quiet night in, and who wants the night included.


Book of the Month sends a book. Introverts Retreat sends the night you were planning to read it. Each box carries what the seller calls a highly rated new-release novel in the genre you choose (general fiction, horror and thriller, science fiction and fantasy, romance, or mystery and suspense) plus a soy candle, a scented soap, a bath salt soak, a sweet treat, and your pick of hot cocoa, loose-leaf tea, or ground coffee. Skip the bath and the seller doubles the treat and the drink instead. The listing has a 4.5 rating from 300 reviews and ships free.


#### What feels familiar


A new release, chosen for you, on a monthly rhythm. The genre menu maps closely to the categories on BOTM’s own shortlist.


#### What changes


The book is one item of five or six. You’ll pay about two and a half BOTM credits for the box, and the candle, soak, and snack are where the difference goes. Genre, drink, and the bath-or-treat choice are set when you order, and boxes ship on a fixed schedule rather than a selection window.


Costs less


### Used Books Monthly vs Book of the Month


1st box


25% off


Preferred Seller


[Used Books Monthly](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/used-books-monthly-literaturecyclecom) by Used Books Monthly


From $9.49 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/used-books-monthly-literaturecyclecom)


**Best for:** A bookworm who cares more about the next book than the edition.


BOTM’s pitch is that its hardcovers run $11.99 to $17.99 against the $28 it says an average new hardcover costs. Used Books Monthly drops the price further by dropping the word new. Tick your genres at checkout and the seller pulls two or four gently used books from its inventory that meet its quality standards, a different assortment every time. It has been on Cratejoy since 2021, with a 3.9 rating from 428 reviews, the most-reviewed listing on this list.


#### What feels familiar


Books chosen for you by genre, every month, with the surprise intact.


#### What changes


Used copies, so expect some shelf wear, and no new releases or hardcover promise. Two books come in an envelope and four in a box. Renewals bill on the 15th and ship by the 5th of the following month. The listing doesn’t state a shipping charge, so check the cart.


Signed by the author


### Reveal Book Box Signed Romance vs Book of the Month


[*Individual Signed Romance Book (No frills)*](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/reveal-book-box) by Reveal Book Box


From $13.95 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/reveal-book-box)


**Best for:** The romance devotee who keeps the books, and wants a name on the title page.


Reveal Book Box sends one romance novel a month signed by its author, matched to the preferences you give the seller, from writers it describes as New York Times and USA Today bestsellers along with names you haven’t met yet. This is the seller’s no-frills tier: the book, and nothing packed around it. The listing has a 4.7 rating from 155 reviews, the highest on this list, and the seller has been on Cratejoy since 2022.


#### What feels familiar


One book, no swag, chosen by someone who reads the genre, on a monthly cadence, for less than a BOTM credit. If early-release and limited editions were the draw, a copy signed by the author is its own kind of limited edition.


#### What changes


Romance only, and no choosing at all beyond the preferences you share. It ships by USPS rather than on a fixed date, and only to US addresses. The listing doesn’t say hardcover or paperback, so don’t assume either, and it doesn’t state a shipping charge.


Classics, shipped worldwide


### Bookishly Tea & Book Club vs Book of the Month


20% off


[TEA & BOOK CLUB](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/tea-vintage-book-club-bookishlysteaandbookclub) by Bookishly


From $17.57 / box


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/tea-vintage-book-club-bookishlysteaandbookclub)


**Best for:** Anyone outside the US and Canada, or a TBR that’s missing the classics.


Bookishly, a UK seller on Cratejoy since 2020, works from the other end of the shelf. Each month brings a surprise classic paperback (a Wordsworth Classic wrapped in one of Bookishly’s own dust jackets) with four tea pyramids from Jenier World of Teas and a matching bookmark. There’s a coffee version at the same price. The Tea & Book Club has a 4.4 rating from 64 reviews, and because it posts from Britain by international airmail, it reaches places BOTM can’t.


#### What feels familiar


One book a month, chosen by someone else, in a jacket made to look good on a shelf. The paperback is the difference. The reason to keep it is the same.


#### What changes


The book is a classic rather than a new release, so part of the backlist may already be on your shelf. The tea is the extra. Parcels go by Royal Mail in the UK, with free shipping there, or by airmail elsewhere, which takes longer than BOTM’s domestic delivery.


For a teen


### Owl Post Books YA Imagination Box vs Book of the Month


1st box


50% off


Preferred Seller


[14 & Up Young Adult Imagination Box and Mini Subscriptions](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bowl-post-books-ya-fantasy-imagination-subscription-bowlpostbooks) by Owl Post Books


From $19.99 / box


Free shipping


[Shop Now](https://www.cratejoy.com/products/bowl-post-books-ya-fantasy-imagination-subscription-bowlpostbooks)


**Best for:** A 14-and-up bookworm with a parent who’d rather not manage a monthly pick.


Owl Post Books builds the box around the teen rather than the adult holding the credit card. Book of the Month lists a young adult genre, but its membership assumes a grown-up logging in by the 6th. Here a quiz sets the picks, an educator with 15-plus years of experience chooses them, and every book is the teen’s to keep. Choose the Mini for one hardcover YA book a month or the Box for three new YA hardcovers. The listing has a 4.6 rating from 151 reviews, the Free Shipping badge, and the seller has sold on Cratejoy since 2020.


#### What feels familiar


New hardcovers, picked by a person, monthly, with shipping included.


#### What changes


The picks come from a quiz rather than a shortlist, and the seller will swap a book the teen already owns. Boxes ship by Media Mail, which takes three to seven days.
